concepts.definition: The engineering design profile for preferred realisation structure inside implementation and design modules, including Ontology-first derivation, low coupling, semantic non-bleed, and explicit authority and effects.
concepts.label: Design module profile

concepts.definition: One engineering semantic truth for a designed boundary, projected into diagrams, matrices, carriers, interfaces, schemas, target design, implementation and proof surfaces without making those projections independent semantic authorities.

grounding.quote: The Ontology is one semantic truth

concepts.label: Ontology

concepts.definition: The smallest parameterised function families making entity lifecycles logically complete; higher-order compositions combine them under an explicit composition and effect algebra. Typical composition categories are unit or lift, sequential, parallel or applicative, fold or evaluation, retry or recovery, recursion or fixed point, and projection.

grounding.quote:
The Ontology derives the smallest parameterised atomic function families
that make the entity lifecycles logically complete.

concepts.label: Atomic functions and higher-order composition

concepts.definition: Function-derivation evidence with minimum columns Discovered functionality, Entity, Atomic function or template, Higher-order composition, Effect class, Required authority, and Disposition.

grounding.quote: | Discovered functionality | Entity | Atomic function or template | Higher-order composition | Effect class | Required authority | Disposition |

concepts.label: Function-derivation evidence

concepts.definition: An irreducible semantic-design relation: function family, identity, authority transition, lifecycle relation, topology, effect, closure law or composition law that cannot honestly be composed from other accepted atoms while preserving meaning. Smallness, typing, naming or independent testability of a realisation does not establish Prime status.

grounding.quote: A Prime semantic atom is one irreducible design relation:

concepts.label: Prime semantic atom

concepts.definition: Review and contraction of the complete candidate semantic-atom family and every proposed realisation projection, covering identities, authority transitions, lifecycle relations, topology, functions, composition laws, effects and closure laws.

grounding.quote:
Prime review evaluates the complete candidate semantic-atom family and
every proposed realisation projection,

concepts.label: Whole-family Prime contraction

concepts.definition: A realisation projection such as a function, class, carrier type, top-level schema record or module. Prime-conformance concerns projection of accepted semantic atoms, not source-code size or one-to-one correspondence.

grounding.quote:
Prime-conformance applies to these realisation projections: functions,
classes, carrier types, top-level schema records and modules.

concepts.label: Realisation unit

concepts.definition: The Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set: the smallest lawful top-level carrier family needed for a boundary's real functionality and authority flow, declared as its carrier inventory. Example roles are source truth, admission, execution, yielded or recovery, effect plan, and public projection carriers.

grounding.quote:
The IACS is the smallest
set of carriers required to carry the real functionality and authority
flow of the boundary.

concepts.label: Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set

concepts.definition: Subordinate Payload is detail inside a boundary, not top-level by default. The Promotion Test is the explicit test for becoming a top-level type. Boundary Inflation is promotion of subordinate detail into peer types without irreducible need.

grounding.quote:
- Subordinate Payload: payload detail that exists inside that boundary but
  is not top-level by default;

concepts.label: Subordinate Payload, Promotion Test and Boundary Inflation

concepts.definition: A boundary-bounded design asset whose domain classDiagram, execution sequenceDiagram and lifecycle stateDiagram-v2 are distinct fidelity-checked Ontology projections and jointly a sign-off surface for identity, authority, behaviour, lifecycle and axiom conformance.
concepts.label: Three-view design asset

conditions: An accepted material-frame basis and a declared bounded action are given.
concepts.definition: The selected method basis and accepted design together supply durable reasoning state sufficient to recover every governing relation in the action's causally closed affected set and classify its effect on each relation. Method supplies required relations and reasoning law; design supplies concrete invariant values.

grounding.quote:
The two inputs are distinct and neither
substitutes for the other:

concepts.label: Invariant reconstruction sufficiency

concepts.definition: Source-defined decisions about one action's effect on one governing relation: preserves leaves it intact; changes alters it and requires re-entry at that relation; duplicates establishes an equivalent path explicitly disposed as constituent, replica, replacement or deliberately independent realisation; violates contradicts the relation or leaves an equivalent path undisposed.

grounding.quote: | preserves | leaves the relation intact and operates inside it | `satisfied` |

concepts.label: Preserve, change, duplicate and violate decisions

concepts.definition: Assessment of product, graph, language, runtime, handler and module axioms for an active boundary. Minimum columns: Axiom, Ontology evidence, Authority, Domain evidence, Sequence evidence, State evidence, Native enforcement, Admission/compiler enforcement, Verdict, Gap owner. Domain verdicts are pass, fail and reasoned not_applicable; cause-selected core values and absence of a result remain distinct.

grounding.quote: | Axiom | Ontology evidence | Authority | Domain evidence | Sequence evidence | State evidence | Native enforcement | Admission/compiler enforcement | Verdict | Gap owner |

concepts.label: Cross-view axiom evaluation

concepts.definition: Separate Ontology and design-pack acceptance results owned by the design authority at the design gate. Each consumes availability and assessment, including decision completeness, axiom verdicts and cross-view proofs. accepted is the accept disposition mapped to satisfied for the candidate's acceptance at its declared boundary.

grounding.quote:
The Ontology verdict and the design verdict are each an acceptance
result: a decision that consumes the results of assessment, distinct from
them.

concepts.label: Ontology and design acceptance

concepts.definition: A subordinate projection revealing computational structure hidden by domain identities: abstract data types, keys and identity structures, algorithms, algebraic laws, mutation and effect boundaries, selected implementations and domain-to-computational mappings. Material components declare semantic and operational role sets; technology capability confers no authority.

grounding.quote:
At a material semantic boundary, the design projects the
domain design into its computational realisation:

concepts.label: Computational realisation projection and role sets

concepts.definition: Optional theoretical framing: a Markov object is a candidate identity-bearing cut, a stable self-bounding pattern whose effective blanket separates identity-bearing from context-bearing structure. IACS analogises the smallest lawful cut; promotion tests independent boundary authority; inflation mistakes fragments for peer objects; strong boundary typing prevents fuzzy or controller-owned identity.

grounding.quote:
It treats a Markov object
as a candidate identity-bearing cut:

concepts.label: Markov-object theoretical framing

concepts.definition: Recommended module roles: carrier defines typed immutable inputs, outputs, contracts, transitions, records or envelopes; semantic kernel transforms carriers without effects; effect shell emits events, publishes files, calls networks or subprocesses, persists or delivers to operators; projection derives read models or reports from authoritative truth; binding/adapter translates external boundaries to internal carriers without semantic invention; constructor/materialisation writes artifacts from admitted carriers and explicit plans. These roles bound reasoning about ownership, consumption, emission and sufficient proof, and expose recurrence.

grounding.quote:
Recommended
roles are:

concepts.label: Module role taxonomy

concepts.definition: Semantic functions may encounter inputs outside their admitted domains. Their returned outcomes are Product domain values, distinct from the method's core results; an evaluation consuming such outcomes returns its own core value.
concepts.label: Semantic function and Product outcomes

concepts.definition: Typed values carrying source truth; preferred realisation constructs or parses carriers, transforms one into another carrier or closed result, and projects without mutation.

grounding.quote:
The
preferred shape: a constructor or parser produces a typed carrier;

concepts.label: Typed carrier

concepts.definition: An explicit boundary for effects such as file writes, network calls, subprocess execution, event append, manifest publication, prompt delivery and database mutation.

grounding.quote:
Typical effect edges include file writes, network calls, subprocess
execution, event append, manifest publication, prompt delivery and
database mutation.

concepts.label: Effect edge

concepts.definition: A surface governing, observing, routing, auditing or evaluating another actor or substrate. Governance describes state, preserved structure, unresolved identities or pressure, eligibility, lawful edit/proof frontier, admitted policy identity and continuity; strategy prescribes how another actor should work.

grounding.quote:
Governance surfaces describe the state, boundary
and admissible routes; strategy surfaces prescribe how another actor
should do the work.

concepts.label: Governance and strategy surfaces

concepts.definition: A repeated realisation pattern appearing across more than one processed boundary is a commonisation candidate. Usually it is non-product-truth, authority-neutral, reused across at least two tickets or boundaries and consumable through local adapters without ownership change. Typical candidates include expectation derivation, nested contract/policy carriers, proof fixtures, effect plans and constructors without semantic ownership.

grounding.quote:
When the same realisation pattern appears across more than one processed
boundary, review treats that pattern as a commonisation candidate

concepts.label: Recurrence and commonisation

concepts.definition: Bounded design review of a processed boundary against accepted design and the exact closure claim, including causal reconstruction of the selected function and preservation of the distinction between current defects and optional discoveries.

grounding.quote:
The processed boundary is checked
against its accepted design basis and exact closure claim before the
ticket claims closure under this profile.

concepts.label: Bounded design review

concepts.definition: The subject's provenance ledger for received rc.2 DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD rows and one IDENTITY_METHOD row, distinguishing conserved material, proposed supersessions, new result mappings and predecessor-implicit tightenings. Routes are provenance only, not independent operative rules or proof of conservation.

grounding.quote:
Every conserved row
is restated in the receiving member's own text; a route is provenance
only.

concepts.label: Source-disposition ledger

concepts.definition: Tier-1 member owning justification and acceptance of claims: evidence, independent assessment, review results, acceptance, realisation conformance and equivalence ladder, frame and method qualification, and actual-use evidence of adequate attention. It consumes FOUNDATIONS core results and defines no result values itself.

grounding.quote: Tier 1. Owns how claims are justified and accepted:

concepts.label: EVALUATION

concepts.definition: A load-bearing claim specifies exact subject, claimed property, governing basis, witness-to-claim relation, nearest excluded weaker property and falsifier before witness selection. Recursive or repeated construction claims distinguish preservation, progress, termination and outcome satisfaction.

grounding.quote:
A load-bearing claim names its exact subject, the property claimed, the
governing basis, the relation between witness and claim, the nearest weaker
property it excludes, and its falsifier, before a witness is selected.

concepts.label: Load-bearing claim

grounding.quote:
Every row is one of: derived through an admitted atomic function; derived
through a declared higher-order composition; deferred with an owner and
re-entry condition; excluded by current product authority; or unresolved
as a named gap

constraints.statement: Variation only in entity kind, projection kind, transition kind, policy or subordinate payload should normally be a typed parameter or closed variant of one family, rather than another peer function. Every functionality row has exactly a listed disposition: admitted atomic derivation, declared higher-order derivation, deferral with owner and re-entry condition, exclusion by current product authority, or named unresolved gap. Where higher-order behaviour exists, Ontology names its governing composition/effect algebra and design states applicable identity, closure, associativity, cardinality, effect and authority-conservation laws explicitly. Iterative discovery of composition, effects and implementation is permitted only while co_evolution_admissible(B) holds; otherwise only a disposable spike may provide evidence across affected unresolved, contradictory or materially non-equivalent relations before acceptance. Every retained result is reconciled into accepted design before promotion or closure. No private helper, loop, adapter or endpoint may become an undeclared constructor.
constraints.uncertainty: The definition of co_evolution_admissible(B) is outside the supplied body.

grounding.quote:
Every accepted Prime atom declares the admitted domain over which its law
holds, and within that domain it governs every admitted instance.

constraints.statement: Prime is decided at semantic-design altitude. Atom-to-realisation mappings may be many-to-many only with explicit mapping and no rival meaning or authority. An atomic function is not proven Prime before complete candidate-family contraction. Every accepted atom declares a domain and governs every admitted instance there. Later use cases compose or parameterise it, without local fork, shadow, specialisation or reinterpretation. An out-of-domain case may justify proposing another candidate for admission; an in-domain counterexample falsifies the shared atom and re-enters at its design boundary, never authorising a feature-local replacement. Without a declared domain an atom remains candidate and supplies neither Prime acceptance nor realisation Prime-conformance.

conditions: Before promotion.

grounding.quote:
A function-and-carrier-only pass does not
establish whole-family Prime

constraints.statement: Review covers the complete family and every proposed projection, not just functions/carriers or isolated atoms. It asks whether operations are typed parameters of one function, commands lifecycle transitions over one entity, reads projections over one source truth, or implementations applications of one higher-order function; whether a candidate adds independent identity, authority, effect, lifecycle, reuse or public pattern-match semantics; whether every atom kind enters the same contraction; whether every realisation maps explicitly to accepted atoms; and whether any projection introduces, duplicates or reinterprets meaning or authority. Individually plausible functions are not a Prime family if one parameterised template plus closed variants preserves the same meaning and authority. Visible recurrence is contracted during design; post-implementation recurrence review does not replace this pass.

conditions: At a material semantic boundary.
exceptions: Work inside an accepted boundary cites its existing Prime basis rather than recreating it.

grounding.quote: Contraction preserves root authority and every retained semantic relation.

constraints.statement: Contract each candidate atom and then the complete resulting family. Local irreducibility or local realisation conformance does not establish global Prime when identity, authority, function, lifecycle, topology, effect or projection meaning is duplicated. Preserve root authority and every retained relation; fewer files, functions, operations or authoring surfaces cannot compensate for another authority source or truth path. Evidence states the complete candidate family; each atom's stable identity, irreducible relation, admitted domain and falsification condition; whole-family contraction relation; retained meaning and authority before/after; accepted loss; and an explicit total mapping from every proposed projection to accepted atoms.

exceptions: Implementation branches and test expectations preserve Ontology but need not be enumerated by it.

grounding.quote:
Each design projection identifies its Ontology source and the identity,
relationship, lifecycle, authority, function or effect law it preserves.

constraints.statement: Class/domain, sequence, state/lifecycle diagrams, authority/effect matrices, IACS, public APIs and operation registers, SDK/CLI surfaces, schemas/codecs/manifests/catalogues, architecture and module design, implementation through accepted target design, and test/proof inventories through requirements and accepted design preserve one Ontology and acquire no independent semantic authority. Every design projection identifies its Ontology source and preserved identity, relationship, lifecycle, authority, function or effect law. Intentional omission or flattening declares accepted loss and a failure condition. Target design may add structural HOW, never rival semantic meaning. Implementation and tests trace through accepted design. An operation, sequence message, transition, carrier or effect lacking that trace to accepted Ontology is ungrounded and excluded from the active product line. Branches and test expectations trace to requirements plus accepted design.

grounding.quote:
A top-level realisation unit is Prime-conformant only when it projects one
or more accepted Prime atoms without introducing, duplicating or
reinterpreting semantic authority.

constraints.statement: Derive Prime atoms from the logically complete candidate Ontology before proposing top-level units; whole-family Prime is evidence for accepting that basis. Target design, IACS, modules, source functions, schemas and tests project accepted atoms without originating Prime meaning. Typed closure alone does not justify a top-level type. A top-level unit is Prime-conformant only if it projects accepted atoms without introducing, duplicating or reinterpreting semantic authority; topology/effect boundaries are first derived and accepted as atoms. Typical lawful reasons include new work-graph topology/branch, typed carrier transform, effect boundary, validation/admission boundary or projection boundary. A unit existing only to shorten a call site without a semantic boundary, aggregate unrelated behaviour, rename an old interface, shuttle data through a wrapper, hide mutation/fallback/orchestration, name a payload variant without authority, expose internal records without irreducibility, mirror a carrier with small field differences, or multiply peer classes due to typing discomfort is non-conformant. Prefer composition, existing lawful functions, sharper fewer boundaries and carrier families. The aim is preventing semantic fragmentation/helper sprawl, not minimising lines.

grounding.quote:
Prime review accounts for
governance cost as well as implementation count:

constraints.statement: Apply ACTIVATION §6's ambiguity-removed versus reasoning-complexity relation to Prime contraction. Review cuts, realisation units, runtime modules and work items are distinct; many-to-one and one-to-many relations are allowed, with no administrative demand for one-to-one decomposition. Contraction is unsuccessful if it increases authority centres, maintained truth surfaces, acceptance boundaries, dependency cycles, manually reconciled projections or review burden. Evidence stays proportional to semantic change and risk; no artifact or review per concern is required.
constraints.uncertainty: The owning proportionality relation is referenced but not supplied.

conditions: Defining a schema, carrier family or typed public boundary.

grounding.quote: The required carrier-set evidence

constraints.statement: Derive IACS from accepted Ontology before naming subordinate payloads or implementation modules; it should be named before subordinate records, helper results or branch detail. Extra branch payloads, persistence details, read-model rows or typing-only field groupings do not automatically justify top-level carriers. Evidence cites accepted Ontology and function derivation, declares IACS, maps every carrier to its identity/lifecycle/function/authority/effect/projection law, classifies authoritative versus downstream carriers, treats every other shape as subordinate by default, keeps subordinate detail private unless it passes Promotion Test, and reconciles typed implementation before closure. IACS is an Ontology projection, never its replacement or first source of entity/function/lifecycle/authority meaning. Undeclared accepted Ontology or IACS leaves a schema incomplete. Co-evolution permits Ontology, evidence, implementation and tests to develop together only while co_evolution_admissible(B) holds; exposed missing meaning cannot self-ratify. Before promotion or closure, Ontology and IACS are accepted and implementation reconciled. Under design-gated sequencing, the affected unresolved, contradictory or materially non-equivalent relation is accepted before retained implementation establishes it.
constraints.uncertainty: ASSURANCE §2, §7 and §15 bind tests and unit proof to this inventory; their bodies and the head-of-member binding are not supplied.

conditions: Any addition, removal, merge or split of a carrier.

grounding.quote: The IACS is not numerically frozen.

constraints.statement: Revision is lawful through accepted Ontology and design re-entry. For every revision, accepted design re-derives the complete IACS and classifies all additions/removals/merges/splits; reruns Promotion Test and Boundary Inflation prohibition over the full revised set; updates every conformance/checker subject to the declared composite carrier relation under EVALUATION §1, including freeze/revision in §3; and reconciles implementation before promotion or closure. A prohibition without a lawful revision path is false. Revision is false if gates examine only new carriers, assurance retains weaker or obsolete subjects, or implementation remains unreconciled before closure.
constraints.uncertainty: EVALUATION §1 is supplied; its referenced §3 freeze and revision law is not.

conditions: Promoting subordinate detail to a top-level class, dataclass, TypedDict, enum or named schema record.

grounding.quote:
A Subordinate Payload may
be promoted to a top-level type only when at least one of these is true:

constraints.statement: A top-level type must justify an architectural boundary. At least one necessary promotion ground is authoritative source-carrier status; public or persisted contract boundary; public outcome-family variant directly pattern-matched by consumers; reuse across several modules without semantic bleed; or independent versioning, publication or admission. These grounds do not erase other conformance obligations. Promotion is unlawful for a candidate that is only internal detail of a larger carrier, a field group used once within one module, a temporary open-dictionary typing shim, a private variation crossing no true interface, or a cosmetic/local-field mirror. A shape needing no independent authority, independent reuse or direct pattern-match semantics stays subordinate and nested/private/local. Promotion bears the burden of proof; designers/reviewers should assume subordination until an irreducible boundary is shown.

conditions: Schema work, including schemas or tickets listing a wide type family.

grounding.quote:
Typed closure does not excuse Boundary
Inflation.

constraints.statement: Declare IACS, authoritative types, downstream types, subordinate shapes and intentionally deferred promotions; distinguish IACS from subordinate detail in wide type lists or incur design drift. Inflation includes promoting payloads because typing feels difficult, exposing internal records without a new authoritative boundary, near-identical peer types where one carrier family suffices, or silently turning one migration into several parallel schema migrations. It is design debt, not progress; typed closure does not excuse it.

conditions: Derivation from an existing design line, released tenant or reference implementation.

grounding.quote:
design-method completion does not rest
on code comparison alone

constraints.statement: Required evidence runs constitutional WHAT → reference design → target Ontology with reference mapping → target design mapping → target module boundary assets → implementation. Minimum assets name reference source surfaces; accepted target Ontology disposing reference entities/functions/lifecycle/authority/effects/projections; target surfaces replacing or binding sources; explicit preserved, reshaped, deferred or delivery-binding-demoted mappings; and required target module assets including Ontology-derived IACS and three-view asset. Completion cannot rest on code comparison or file porting alone; absent derivation means not yet complete. The chain prevents importing drift, quirks, helpers or accidental authority without an audit trail.

conditions: Every new or materially changed semantic or typed module boundary.
exceptions: Unchanged boundaries cite their accepted basis; local realisation with no material semantic-boundary delta does not recreate the gate.

grounding.quote:
Every new or materially changed semantic or typed module boundary carries
one accepted Ontology and one complete three-view Mermaid design asset
before the boundary is promoted or claims design-method closure

constraints.statement: One accepted Ontology and a complete three-view asset precede promotion or closure. Evidence, implementation and tests may develop together before the gate when co_evolution_admissible(B) holds; otherwise affected unresolved, contradictory or materially non-equivalent relations are accepted before retained implementation establishes them. The distinct domain, execution and lifecycle views are mandatory projections rather than decorative or peer truths. One broad flowchart is not a substitute.

grounding.quote: The design asset cites one accepted Ontology for the active boundary

constraints.statement: Include or reference entity/relationship inventory, invariants/cardinalities, entity-lifecycle completeness matrix, authority matrix, atomic/higher-order derivation matrix, applicable governing composition/effect algebra, whole-family Prime contraction with every accepted atom's domain and projection mapping, and explicit deferred/excluded/unresolved functionality. A boundary slice may derive from a wider accepted product Ontology only with parent citation and preservation of parent identity, relationship, lifecycle, authority and function law. Copying selected rows into a local model without that derivation creates another truth surface.

conditions: A declared bounded action and its causally closed affected set.

grounding.quote:
Sufficiency is bound to a declared action and its affected set; it is
not a claim over an unbounded space of possible future changes,

constraints.statement: Recover every governing relation and its preserve/change/duplicate/violate classification from selected method plus accepted design; neither input substitutes for the other, and restating method decision law in design is duplication. Dialogue, commentary, prior-agent memory and implementation folklore are not durable reasoning state. Particular reviewer performance proves neither sufficiency nor insufficiency. No new artifact is required: existing Ontology evidence, authority matrix, transformation-admission relation, frame declaration, views and module mapping carry the obligation. The law is false if accepted design omits any governing relation in the affected set or classification requires withheld history/memory/folklore. When tested, use named cases with known governing relations and expected decisions, withholding those informal sources.

conditions: Predicate: the action is admissible in the acting frame on the current governing basis.

grounding.quote: The four decisions are a refinement of the core result algebra

constraints.statement: Each decision maps to exactly one core value carried with both predicate and decision: preserves and disposed duplicates → satisfied; changes → invalid_basis; violates → falsified. Preserves/duplicates leave the accepted relation intact. A change must re-enter and change the relation at its own locus before action acceptance; even an otherwise lawful change accepted only inside the acting frame is violation. Disposition, not equivalence, separates lawful duplication from violation. Contradiction or an undisposed equivalent path is the violation counterexample. If none of the four decisions is reached, use the cause-selected core value; insufficient admissible evidence gives indeterminate with what would decide. If the cause is insufficiency of method plus design, that falsifies the sufficiency law. Do not read lawful change as violation or acting-frame permission, or violation as re-entry.
constraints.uncertainty: The full external core algebra and re_enter disposition are not supplied.

conditions: The active boundary's structural domain projection.

grounding.quote: The `classDiagram` is the structural domain projection of the Ontology

constraints.statement: Show identities/cardinalities rather than helper-class decomposition; ownership, invariants and lawful lifecycle relationships; atomic families and entity inputs/outputs crossing the boundary; higher-order relationships determining its shape; IACS-to-Prime mappings; subordinate and effect-edge-only payloads; downstream projections; deferred families outside the slice; authoritative/downstream roles; public/module-local visibility; and composition, containment, association and real variants. Standard stereotypes are <<prime-conformant>>, <<subordinate>>, <<effect-edge>>, <<deferred>>, <<authoritative>>, <<downstream>>; visibility + means public/exported and - module-local/private. Standard relationship expectations are composition for owned subordinate payloads, association for downstream consumption, and inheritance only for real variant/outcome families.

conditions: The execution/behavioural projection.
exceptions: A participant absent from the domain model is permitted here if explicitly external.

grounding.quote:
Every
message also binds to an Ontology function and its admitted authority
role; actor identity or call reachability alone does not authorise a
message

constraints.statement: Show the supported path from admitted input to result or truthful stop, naming owner and required authority of every decision, admission, execution, projection and effect boundary. Where applicable include malformed input/output, retry, recursion, fan-out/in, nested workflow and human escalation. Every participant is domain-modelled or explicitly external. Every message binds to a declared carrier transform, graph/computation constructor, interpreter action or effect-handler call, and to an Ontology function with admitted authority role. A private loop, service method, plugin, shell or script cannot silently substitute for a declared workflow transition. Identity or reachability alone does not authorise a message.

conditions: The lifecycle projection of the active boundary.

grounding.quote:
It shows the complete admitted lifecycle for
the active boundary,

constraints.statement: Show every admitted lifecycle state the boundary can produce, including refusal, blocked, continuation, retry, escalation and terminal states. Every transition binds to an Ontology function and names its owning authority, admission, compiler, interpreter, event, projection or external act. Controller-local memory cannot be lifecycle truth when the product declares replay, event, graph or carrier ownership.

grounding.quote:
The cross-view evaluation proves that: every element in each view derives
from the accepted Ontology;

constraints.statement: Evaluate every applicable product/graph/language/runtime/handler/module axiom. Required cross-view proofs cover Ontology derivation of all view elements; derived/deferred/excluded/gap disposition of all functionality; domain existence of every sequence participant and lifecycle carrier; declared semantic/effect boundary for every message; admitted-truth derivation of every transition; explicit authority paths for every function/transition and no implicit widening through composition; public operations as Ontology projections rather than peers; no direct raw-probabilistic-output transition to accepted/closed; handler/plugin interior ownership only when runtime owns admission, events, continuation and closure; native-type enforcement of locally decidable relations; and admission/semantic-compilation ownership of global references, completeness and realisation gaps. For graph-native work every batch/retry/recursion/nested workflow is visible in declared graph/compute algebra. A relied-on semantic_not_realized constructor is blocking and cannot be replaced by plugin, shell, service, script or test-harness imperative glue.
constraints.uncertainty: This section's universal domain-participant wording differs from the sequence section's explicit external-actor alternative.

conditions: Predicate: on the exact Ontology and design basis, the boundary design meets the axiom OR the axiom does not apply.

grounding.quote:
an
unresolved premise supports no `not_applicable`,

constraints.statement: pass maps to satisfied when cited Ontology, view and enforcement evidence establishes conformance. not_applicable maps to satisfied only for the disjunction, never for meeting the axiom; it requires a false applicability premise on basis-bound facts, with reason naming those facts and the excluding scope authority. Unresolved applicability does not support it. fail maps to falsified when an applicable axiom has a named violating element/message/transition/authority path/enforcement counterexample. Record verdict with value, retaining exclusion versus conformance. If evaluated but none applies, record cause-selected core value and what would decide: indeterminate for undecidable admissible evidence, including unresolved applicability when conformance is not established; out_of_frame for undeclared needed relation/evaluator capability; invalid_basis for an unsupportive Ontology/design basis. An applicable but unevaluated axiom has no result. None of these is pass; undecided/unevaluated is neither pass nor fail, and exclusion is neither conformance nor failure.

conditions: A new or semantically changed boundary is being promoted or claims design-method closure.

grounding.quote:
a matrix in which every applicable axiom is
`pass` is evidence for the design authority, never the verdict,

constraints.statement: Ontology and design verdicts must both be accepted before promoting affected implementation, public contract or semantic carrier or claiming closure. Failed applicable axioms, missing functionality dispositions, unresolved authority paths and blocking realisation gaps keep acceptance non-accepted. So do any axiom result other than satisfied, an applicable axiom with no result, or a resultless axiom whose applicability is not established false. A produced pack supplies neither assessment nor acceptance; even all-pass evidence is not the authority's verdict. Non-accepted may mean another ACTIVATION §3 disposition or no disposition yet; the latter is no acceptance result. Decision completeness is the acceptance criterion, and mandatory non-satisfied results/gaps cannot combine into satisfied.
constraints.uncertainty: The other three acceptance dispositions and their complete mappings are not provided.

exceptions: An unchanged realization_refactor cites its accepted basis, identifies touched projections and proves no entity/relationship/lifecycle/authority/function/effect/public-semantics delta, reusing the verdict without a new Ontology or ceremony.

grounding.quote: Until the design gate is accepted it is provisional evidence:

constraints.statement: While co_evolution_admissible(B) holds, implementation may precede/develop with design and be retained after reconciliation, but remains provisional until acceptance: no semantic authorship, publication authority, promotion or closure. Otherwise only disposable spikes cross affected unresolved/contradictory/materially non-equivalent relations before acceptance. Existing implementation may inform retrospective review; newly discovered material ambiguity, contradiction or non-equivalent network makes decision_complete(B) false and activates the gate for that decision. Promotion/closure wait for accepted Ontology, three views and axiom evaluation. Assess code against prior authority without rationalising unlawful implementation by rewriting Ontology/diagrams. Mixing unrelated bootstrap, harness, projection or delivery shapes into an active semantic asset merely for apparent completeness is defective. Missing Ontology, any view, cross-view evaluation or either accepted verdict means incomplete; only admissible provisional co-evolution may continue, with promotion/publication/closure blocked.

conditions: Every material realisation component and every material semantic boundary.

grounding.quote:
A component may
lawfully hold several roles.

constraints.statement: Declare each material component's semantic/operational role set; multiple roles are lawful and authority-bearing composition/use preserves the applicable authority relation. Behaviour within an abstract declared role is ordinary variation; new operational responsibility or new semantic/authoritative role is design change requiring re-entry. Out-of-role use cannot silently establish identity, admission, lifecycle, ordering, closure or projection truth. Cross-view evaluation establishes domain and computational projections as one system. Every material producer-consumer path identifies fact establishment, consumers, basis/invalidators, effect boundaries, retained alternatives and accumulated work, including material method/assurance operations; local success cannot establish a whole-path claim and different names do not establish distinct responsibilities. Material algorithmic work declares supported dimensions, workload/growth and operational assumptions. Bind acceptance limits and owner before qualification; workloads/limits are Product-owned. Challenge assumptions on representative paths and material growth; directly observe work if elapsed time cannot locate it without repeating merely to count. Use existing design/proof surfaces; no extra accounting system or fixed complexity is required.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed authority preservation, whole-path validity/reuse and cost separation laws are externally referenced.

grounding.quote: The projection is subordinate.

constraints.statement: Computational similarity yields a commonisation candidate, then semantic/operational equivalence evaluation, then reuse, parameterised common relation or justified separation; it never decides identity, ownership or authority. Material non-equivalence in identity/key law, ownership, ordering, admissible mutation, consistency/concurrency, retention, failure, access policy, lifecycle or authority over truth requires separation. Other differences justify separation only if parameterisation/adaptation would weaken ownership, authority, lifecycle, failure or operational constraints; difference alone does not discharge Prime/recurrence review. Each material algorithmic obligation in M(B) has both a semantic disposition (existing accepted relation, extension, new candidate) and a realisation disposition (consume, local implementation, optimise, adapt, deliberate duplication under stated non-semantic constraints). Isolation, substrate, performance, security and dependency ownership can justify independent implementations. Local implementation cannot claim existing semantic/authoritative truth as newly owned. Falsifiers include materially equivalent components without semantic disposition, a generic block becoming authority, commonising superficially similar operations despite differing identity/ordering/failure/ownership/lifecycle law, or locally claiming an existing relation as new truth.
constraints.uncertainty: The full M(B) definition is not supplied.

grounding.quote: This is a theoretical justification, not an extra prerequisite.

constraints.statement: The operational profile stands alone. Engineering Ontology requires neither world-model adoption, Constraint-Emergence Ontology nor any metaphysical or empirical claim. Theoretical framing does not extend scope; engineering rules remain applicable where the Markov-object construct is irrelevant, unavailable or only candidate-class.

conditions: This profile governs the realisation boundary.

grounding.quote:
modules should be
classified by role

constraints.statement: Modules should be classified by the recommended roles to bound traversal reasoning under finite context, attention and time, not for naming ceremony. Boundaries should make ownership, inputs, outputs and sufficient proof inspectable without rereading the system and reveal repeated local computations for library consolidation. Design-to-module evidence, module-derived tests and lifecycle confirmation are ASSURANCE §14–§16 law read through the member's declared binding.
constraints.uncertainty: The ASSURANCE bodies and head-of-member binding are absent.

conditions: Projects using this profile.

grounding.quote:
Projects using this profile prefer one algebraic primitive plus
projections over several local decision systems, and prefer total
functions, closed enums, explicit state and deterministic folds

constraints.statement: Prefer one algebraic primitive plus projections over several local decision systems, and total functions, closed enums, explicit state and deterministic folds. These are preferences, with provenance attributed to rc.2 compression documents and expressly not to an rc.2 body statement.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited compression sources are unavailable for independent provenance comparison.

grounding.quote: Convenience is not sufficient justification.

constraints.statement: Source truth should use typed immutable values unless mutation is materially necessary. Prefer constructor/parser → typed carrier, transforms returning another carrier or closed result, and non-mutating projections. Mutable state requires explicit justification when performance-critical, host-runtime/framework-required or modelling a genuinely stateful boundary rather than semantic truth. Convenience is insufficient.

exceptions: Totality is limited by what language and problem allow; explicit typed failure is preferred when practical.

grounding.quote:
Semantic functions should be total or as close to total as the language
and problem allow

constraints.statement: Semantic functions should be total or as close as feasible. Prefer boundary rejection of invalid input, kernels consuming admitted carriers, practical typed explicit failures, Result-like/closed outcomes, explicit validation and unsupported/rejected outcomes. Avoid hidden-precondition partial functions, semantic .get(...) fallback chains and controllers rebuilding missing truth from defaults. Product outcome values must remain distinct from method evaluation results.

grounding.quote: Effects should be explicit and isolated

constraints.statement: Effects should be explicit and isolated; semantic kernels should not perform them while deciding law. Prefer admitting/parsing authoritative input, transforming to typed plan/outcome, applying effects at the edge from that plan/outcome, then publishing events/projections downstream. A function both deciding meaning and writing should be treated as suspect, not automatically assigned a stronger source-unstated result.

grounding.quote:
A
module is acting as an unlawful semantic centre when reviewers have to
read it to discover what counts as closure,

constraints.statement: No controller, manager, service method, runtime loop or public wrapper should be a hidden semantic centre by procedural orchestration, rebuilding payload fragments, rehydrating law from legacy files/fallbacks, or flattening types into dictionaries/.get chains. A module is an unlawful semantic centre if reviewers must read it to discover closure, identity, failure, next work or current truth. Those meanings should already exist in carriers, contracts or explicit design modules.

grounding.quote:
The preferred dependency direction is
`carriers -> semantic kernels -> effect shells -> projections`,

constraints.statement: Coupling should be reduced by dependency shape, not just file count. Prefer the stated carriers → kernels → effect shells → projections direction over controllers → helpers → mutable runtime state → projections. Excess coupling exists when many modules mutate the same object, projections infer truth from implementation state, consumers silently rebuild source truth from raw artifacts, or tests pass only because several modules duplicate meaning. Reduction means fewer places can invent meaning.
constraints.uncertainty: Arrow notation is retained as source direction without inventing import or execution semantics.

conditions: A boundary governs, observes, routes, audits or evaluates another actor, executor, builder or substrate.
exceptions: Strategy ownership is explicitly ratified as part of the boundary responsibility.
An assessment boundary is explicitly owned for the relevant scores, budgets, counters or heuristic ratings.

grounding.quote:
it publishes governance truth, not
imperative strategy law, unless strategy ownership is explicitly part of
the boundary's ratified responsibility

constraints.statement: Publish governance truth rather than imperative downstream strategy, subject to explicit ownership exceptions. Unlawful drift includes repair/action commands, framework preferences disguised as observability, metrics recreating the actor's own judgment without ownership, and prompts/reports/read models becoming hidden strategy doctrine. A governance/observability system cannot become a replacement decision engine through context, projections, prompts or route helpers.

conditions: A realisation boundary is lawfully open for migration, refactor or bounded implementation.
constraints.statement: The opened area should be improved, subordinate to constitutional truth, ownership evidence and functional equivalence. Lawful cleanup requires locality, preserved boundary behaviour, unchanged truth ownership, no silent payload visibility promotion, and no hidden runtime/persistence/bootstrap effect expansion. Examples include removing local parser re-entry, consolidating local routes, better local algorithms/scans and simplifying proof/tests without changing claims. Cross-module lookup/index/cache/persistence repricing, public carrier/visibility/ownership changes, wider effect/observability doctrine or changed product performance expectations require design re-entry. Cross-boundary opportunities are repricing inputs, not silently absorbed scope. Only owner-admitted follow-up enters separately at the smallest lawful re-entry point; TICKETS controls its recording and ticket-closure effects. Cleanup cannot cover unauthorised redesign.
constraints.uncertainty: The detailed re-entry and ticket mechanisms are external.

conditions: Repeated realisation patterns across processed boundaries.
exceptions: A third local rebuild may conform if review explicitly records do-not-commonise and why it remains boundary-specific.

grounding.quote:
a third local rebuild
is not design-method conformant unless

constraints.statement: Review repetition across more than one processed boundary as a commonisation candidate. TICKETS §6 owns rule-of-two, third-rebuild threshold, commonisation order and library_usage/governing_library/library_rationale on every implementation migration ticket. This profile's design conformance rejects a third rebuild unless it consumes an existing reusable library/surface, extends it before local implementation lands, or records the explicit boundary-specific exception. Tenant-local authority-neutral reusable patterns should be extracted under that order. Ownership, public-carrier, module-boundary or shared-law change is a separate design decision. Commonisation closes only when the selected path consumes the accepted relation and superseded production responsibility is retired or meets SPEC_METHOD §7 retention. Compare removed work and maintained responsibilities across the path; shared names, fewer lines or unused helpers do not prove contraction.
constraints.uncertainty: The externally owned commonisation order and retention relation are not supplied.

conditions: A ticket applies the profile and claims its boundary processed or design-method closed.
exceptions: The check may be normal verification without a separate artifact, round or reviewer.
constraints.statement: Closure should not rest on implementation status alone; check accepted design and exact claim before closure. Determine boundary lawfulness; inclusion of every causally applicable live requirement, accepted relation and retained predecessor claim; competing/ambiguous acceptance-path authority; durable architectural decisions foreclosing admitted Product outcomes; and falsifying issues or hard stops. Reconstruct requirements → Ontology → Prime atoms → IACS → views → target modules → implementation → module-owned proof, beyond previous findings. Hashes establish identity, headings/artifact presence location, and green tests only asserted properties; none supplies missing semantics or substitutes weaker claims. TICKETS retains status, closure, reopening, dependencies and follow-up mechanics. No processed ticket should claim closure before this bounded check completes.

grounding.quote:
The complete selected function is the causal closure of the declared
claim, not the whole Product or the whole history of its construction.

constraints.statement: Scope is the claim's causal closure. Current accepted Ontology/verdict/reconstruction may be reused under ACTIVATION §7 after checking exact scope, traces, applicability and absence of its three invalidators; no fourth is added. Source repricing is changed basis affecting only relevant relations/projections pending impact review; later applicable frontier-changing candidates or evidence defeating dominance are material input changes. New roles, conversations or review occurrences alone do not require reauthoring or new views. Missing/stale/ambiguous coverage is not no-delta proof; changed relations or new counterexamples require affected reconstruction/gate while conserving unaffected support. A falsified claim or applicable hard stop blocks design closure and cannot become satisfied or be waived. Current promotion blocking belongs to EVALUATION §5: domain triggers are falsifying issue, competing/ambiguous authority, unlawful boundary or omitted applicable claims, and durable architectural foreclosure. Wording cannot narrow active authority away. Absorb local cleanup/commonisation only when needed for truth, singular authority, accepted design or avoiding foreclosure. Other discoveries are repricing inputs that do not automatically expand scope, block bounded claims or demand tickets; admitted repricing enters at the smallest lawful re-entry point. Unclaimed future capability/optional cleanup is not implicit work.
constraints.uncertainty: Only examples of the external three invalidators and promotion-blocking law are supplied here; the full owning laws are absent.

conditions: Interfaces cross semantic boundaries.

grounding.quote:
The required shape: each interface family has
one authoritative source truth;

constraints.statement: No interface should bleed authority into another family. Bleed includes reconstructing another interface's truth, projection becoming closure logic, report/prompt becoming admission logic, wrappers deciding kernel semantics, or adapters inventing meaning. Each family has one authoritative source; downstream interfaces consume it; crossing a boundary creates no new semantic centre. Low coupling requires this non-bleed, not merely small functions.

conditions: Projects using this profile.
exceptions: Intentionally retained compatibility is an explicit feature with its own bounded authority and proof.

grounding.quote:
Projects using this profile do not use proxy or partial interface
implementation as a substitute for real migration or real design
completion

constraints.statement: Proxy/partial interfaces cannot substitute for migration or completed design. A new-looking surface forwarding to old authority, rebuilding missing truth from it, retaining it executable under a new name, or keeping proofs green while old law governs is bridge debt. Unless compatibility is explicitly bounded and proven, remove the proxy path.

conditions: Prompts under this profile; particularly clauses intended to enforce design law.

grounding.quote:
A prompt clause that exists to enforce design law
needs provenance and a proof that the clause still causes or prevents the
intended behaviour

constraints.statement: Prompt construction follows ACTIVATION §2. Workers may be told inspection locations and contracts to satisfy. A design-law-enforcing clause needs provenance and proof of continuing causal effect on intended behaviour. The source attributes this claim to an rc.2 compression, explicitly saying no rc.2 body states it.
constraints.uncertainty: The full prompt-construction rule and compression provenance are not supplied.

conditions: Reviewing code under this profile.

grounding.quote:
If these questions cannot be answered cleanly, the realisation is too
coupled or too imperative

constraints.statement: Ask the 56 review questions, preserving their interrogative role: typed semantic law rather than orchestration; transforms over admitted truth; isolated effects; no invented projection closure or alternate query truth; justified bounded local mutation; direct carrier pattern matching; no silent compatibility authority; fail-closed carrier removal; Prime functions; interface non-bleed; Python Any/open payloads/untyped definitions; declared IACS; subordinate retention and promotion proof; no inflation; no increased truth surfaces and reduced duplicates; no foreign payload trusted after ingress; proof before enforcement; governance versus strategy; explicit reference derivation; accurate domain/IACS/visibility/ownership/deferred mapping; module-derived tests; lawful local cleanup and separately admitted cross-boundary opportunity; explicit recurrence and third-rebuild decisions; exact-claim closure/hard-stop review; graph-governed declared outcome traversal and checking whether deterministic units are operative edge traversals; F_D/transforms/effect shells subordinate to GTL/ABG; lifecycle confirmation or named Gap:/Unanswered: phases; proper authority for release/deployment/usage/telemetry/retirement and reasoned authority-compatible non-application; distinct three views; participant/message bindings; admitted lifecycle truth; complete reasoned axiom matrix; blocked unrealised constructors; justified sequencing and acceptance before promotion/closure or design-gated retained implementation; one accepted Ontology before promoted surfaces; identity/relationship/invariant/lifecycle enumeration without mutable CRUD default; applicable proposer/evaluator/verifier/admitter/executor/projector/retirement authority distinct from actor/capability; complete functionality dispositions; complete-family Prime with domains; composition/effect laws and conservation; traceable projections with accepted loss; no downstream meaning exposed as ungrounded by removing Ontology. Failure to answer cleanly diagnoses excessive coupling or imperative design.
constraints.uncertainty: Graph-profile and lifecycle owner laws are referenced beyond the supplied text.

conditions: Review questions concerning material generic capabilities and foundation selection.

grounding.quote: 49. Before constructing a material generic capability or common mechanic,

constraints.statement: Ask whether the capability was stated without Product/domain/module/vendor/file/incumbent labels and declared semantic/authority relations separated from generic mechanics; bounded discovery recorded every searched source/category, cutoff/version, applicability, exclusions, predecessor/incumbent status and unknowns, with later material candidates invalidating affected selection; credible compositions were compared across decision-relevant lifecycle dimensions without incumbent/source-order/local-code/dependency-count preference; hard authority, Product-contract, safety, security, licensing and constructability failures eliminated candidates while unknowns stayed explicit; reused foundations held only assigned roles preserving owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis, lifecycle and refusal invariants; the selected composition was undominated with existing trade-off owner applying declared priorities/risk tolerances rather than undefined total ordering; rejected material candidates had decisive evidence/falsifiers and unresolved frontier remained gap; and newly exposed material generic subproblems recursively re-entered selection before retained implementation.
constraints.uncertainty: The full UP-023 selection relation preceding this chunk is unavailable; these are grounded review questions, not a reconstructed external algorithm.

conditions: A project claims functional bias, pure transforms, immutable carriers, single-owner truth or low coupling.

grounding.quote:
review
explicitly checks

constraints.statement: Explicitly check preservation of constitutional WHAT within lawful HOW; one accepted Ontology deriving all entity/identity/relationship/invariant/lifecycle/authority/function/composition/effect/projection meaning; every create/read/update/retire lifecycle question assigned function, reasoned not_applicable or owned gap; separated actor/capability and authority roles; complete function dispositions without direct verb promotion; contraction before peer promotion and complete Prime/domain/projection evidence; fidelity of IACS/views/contracts/adapters/code/tests; reference-boundary equivalence without drift and reference→target→module mapping before implementation when reference exists; proportional generic foundation selection with bounded discovery, undominated frontier, role/authority conservation and decisive candidate evidence; implementation/tests from common module assets; one truth owner and reduced duplication/controller reconstruction/rival paths. Check admitted inputs, same-input purity, no time/randomness/UUID/environment/process/filesystem/network/global-registry semantic centre, ingress/effect-owned identity creation, immutable new-value carriers, no shared mutable semantic state, direct local-carrier transforms without parser/validator/loader re-entry, rejection of invalid/incomplete ingress truth, ratified carrier-owned defaults, one function owner/responsibility, algebra depending on carrier contracts rather than shells, admission on validation rather than orchestration, no semantic-decision-plus-effect function, typed effects without open-object erasure, and package/bootstrap/controller/adapter/runtime shells subordinate. Check governance facts/eligibility/provenance without imperative strategy; complete current views and axiom matrix with accepted verdict/no bypass; module-owned IACS-derived tests; local behaviour-preserving authority-neutral cleanup; explicit recurrence decisions, consuming/extending existing surfaces or explicit boundary-specific/not-yet-lawful rationale; separate authority-admitted cross-boundary work; bounded exact-claim/hard-stop review; negative proof that imperative/open-payload/effect-erasure bypass fails closed; graph-governed deterministic modules within declared traversals, with repricing if they decide next work/closure/target movement/graph identity; every canonical lifecycle phase answered, reasoned inapplicable or named Gap:/Unanswered:; and release/deployment/use/telemetry/retirement claims confirmed by proper Product/requirement/design/release/operational authority.
constraints.uncertainty: The checklist's unqualified governance and immutability checks coexist with explicit exceptions elsewhere; their reconciliation is retained as a residual.

conditions: A new or materially changed boundary, within the functional checklist's claim context.
exceptions: For unchanged boundaries, accepted basis plus evidence of no material semantic delta suffices; no new Ontology, IACS, three views, cross-view evaluation or unit-test lane is required.

grounding.quote:
For a new or materially changed boundary, the compact hard-gate version of
this checklist is

constraints.statement: Hard-gate checks are accepted Ontology before promotion/closure and design-gated retained implementation of unresolved/contradictory/non-equivalent relations; complete lifecycle/authority/function evidence; whole-family Prime, atom domains, projection mappings and composition/effect algebra; proportional generic foundation selection with discovery/frontier and exact role/authority conservation; pure semantic functions; immutable carriers without shared mutable semantic state; one truth owner; low admission/algebra/effect coupling; no hidden runtime authority; accepted three views; complete axiom evaluation without bypass; semantic-boundary equivalence to specification and any reference; lifecycle confirmation or named gaps; and negative bypass proof. The checklist is language-agnostic across module, carrier, data-entity design and realisation review.

conditions: The profile is adopted for a named boundary.
exceptions: Partial adoption may narrow scope, but cannot omit evidence needed to audit, refactor or reconstruct while claiming completion.

grounding.quote:
inclusion in the selected method cut makes the profile available, and only
Product authority adopts it.

constraints.statement: Availability in the selected method cut is distinct from adoption; only Product authority adopts, with no additional adopter introduced here. Apply consistently across Ontology/architecture derivation, design modules, runtime/execution kernels, prompts/reporting, constructors/materialisers and projections/queries. Carrier/schema/governance migrations should explicitly name closure evaluators in ADR/ticket. Every new/materially changed adopted boundary declares/cites accepted Ontology and evidence of entity lifecycle, authority, function derivation, whole-family Prime, admitted domains, projection mappings and traceability at applicable granularity before completion. Schema/carrier work additionally derives/reconciles IACS; reference-derived boundaries publish reference-target and Ontology-derived three-view assets; active implementation publishes a module-derived unit-test lane before closure. Partial adoption is allowed and its boundary/rule family should be explicit.
constraints.uncertainty: The ledger marks the replacement adopter relation proposed and pending Product-owner acceptance; the body alone does not establish that acceptance.

grounding.quote:
It does not decide release eligibility, exact-cut acceptance, selector
promotion, install policy or operational rollout;

constraints.statement: SPEC_METHOD governs constitutional process, authority flow, repricing and migration; RELEASE release cuts, Product/install/qualification and version-line promotion, exact-cut acceptance and selector decisions; ODD graph-native constructive carriers; this profile internal deterministic design discipline; UX refines UX surfaces and is loaded only for work realising them. For graph-governed products ODD decides the operative outcome traversal/graph function/GTL module/ABG boundary, then this profile governs deterministic realisation/evaluation/adaptation/projection inside it. UX adds render/reducer purity, effect membrane and AssetSurface binding where applicable. ASSURANCE lifecycle confirmation detects build/review lifecycle signal, not release eligibility, acceptance, selector promotion, install or rollout; those remain RELEASE and project release/deployment/operational responsibilities.
constraints.uncertainty: These named members' complete laws are not supplied.

conditions: A consumer-bound ABG-role realisation under the graph-execution profile.

grounding.quote:
the permission is scoped to that role
and does not extend to other runtime realisations

constraints.statement: That realisation may publish default identity generators, validators and normalisers for its own runtime surfaces and default ODD surface kinds used by default F_D helpers. Permission extends only to that bound role, not other runtimes. Default standing, override law, preservation conditions and publication surface belong to IDENTITY §7.
constraints.uncertainty: Override details are unresolved; the ledger additionally describes them as overridable starter conventions/convenience contracts rather than universal doctrine.

grounding.quote:
What this profile does not require (one specific programming language,
elimination of all imperative code, monadic or category-theory vocabulary,
replacing every exception with a custom algebraic type),

constraints.statement: The profile does not require a particular language, removal of all imperative code, monadic/category vocabulary or replacing every exception with a custom algebraic type. Composition/effect algebra remains required where a boundary composes higher-order or effectful computation. SPEC_METHOD §2 owns the complete implementation-shape and non-goal law.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced implementation readability/shape requirements are not fully supplied here.

The predecessor's "must" is
written in the indicative; every "should", "may", "recommended",
"typical", "preferred", "normally", "usually", "minimum", "where
practical" and "allowed" keeps its force.

constraints.statement: Read anchors as rc.2 DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD unless IDENTITY_METHOD is named; loci are this member unless another is named. Conservation and routing are authored provenance claims. Generalisations rename SPEC_METHOD.md/RELEASE_METHOD.md/TICKET_METHOD.md/UX_METHOD.md to tenant SPEC_METHOD/RELEASE/TICKETS/UX; ODD_METHOD and ODD-governed to graph-execution profile while retaining GTL/ABG/F_D/graph-function/edge-traversal terms; UP-021 to ACTIVATION §4, UP-022 to EVALUATION §1/§3, UP-004 to IDENTITY §6, Agentic Construction Execution to ACTIVATION §1, operational lifecycle sufficiency to SPEC_METHOD §2, core migration/retention to SPEC_METHOD §7 and WORLD_MODEL_METHOD to world-model profile. 'This method', 'STDO basis' and 'graph/C constructor' become 'this profile', 'method basis' and 'graph or computation constructor'; old section labels route to successors. Indicative wording carries predecessor must-force while should/may/recommended/typical/preferred/normally/usually/minimum/where-practical/allowed retain their distinct force. Tier-1/2 law is pointed to rather than duplicated.

superseded in its repeated-surprise sentence, proposed and pending the product owner's acceptance
superseded, proposed and pending the product owner's acceptance of the replacement relation

Two replacements are expressly proposed/pending owner acceptance: repeated/cross-cutting surprises trigger diagnosis and bounded design_reframe only if diagnosis establishes an underconstrained design cut, replacing the predecessor's direct surprise-triggered reframe; and Product-authority-only adoption replaces 'Projects may adopt', retaining the four means only as recording methods. It identifies action-decision/core mappings, axiom/core mappings and acceptance-disposition binding as new in this corpus; direct core/no-result handling and non-satisfied/missing-axiom gate blocking as predecessor-implicit tightenings. New law without predecessor row comprises the §1 foundation-to-law family table, deciding nothing beyond cited rules under FOUNDATIONS format/standing, and head-of-member results/design-record clarification including two senses of not_applicable.
constraints.uncertainty: No Product-owner acceptance of the proposed replacements is present; missing predecessor/receiving bodies prevent verification of conservation and exact omitted details.

conditions: Before selecting a witness for a load-bearing claim.

grounding.quote: Without these it is evidence discovery, not proof.

constraints.statement: Specify exact subject/property/basis/witness relation/excluded weaker property/falsifier before witness selection, else the activity is evidence discovery rather than proof. Packaging, syntax, compilation, presence, invocation or local behaviour never substitute for semantic, authority, installed, release or end-to-end claims because easier to measure. Repeated/recursive construction claims state preservation, progress, termination or outcome satisfaction. Witness assertions identify whether their predicate is the full obligation, a necessary condition or part of a sufficient conjunction. Expected results carry assertion provenance and execution carries execution provenance; passing a necessary-condition check establishes only that condition.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed construction-kind and assertion/execution provenance definitions belong to absent ACTIVATION/FOUNDATIONS bodies.

conditions: Assurance supports promotion/closure or claims mechanical enforcement.

grounding.quote:
Evidence over one file
or carrier proves only that boundary; it cannot establish a multi-file or
carrier-set claim.

constraints.statement: Every checker, validator, harness, reviewer or other assurance surface binds the exact claimed subject and authoritative composition relation. Cross-carrier satisfaction/conflict is decided at the declared composite boundary; single-file/carrier evidence cannot close a multi-file/set claim. Mechanical enforcement names an executable/reproducible predicate and witness reachable through the ordinary declared assurance path. Planned/specification-only harnesses are planned evidence, not observed verification. Until predicate and reachable witness are both observed, the claim remains open or explicitly downgraded to the planned property.

grounding.quote:
A claim's quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed its evaluated
evidence.

constraints.statement: Quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed evaluated evidence. Generalising local defects/observations requires declared inference, comparable population, explicit counterexample treatment and governing evidence. Later counterevidence invalidates every dependent verdict until the claim-evidence relation is superseded, withdrawn or requalified. Quantifier/boundary laws are false if assurance measures a weaker/different subject, per-carrier evidence closes an unevaluated composite, enforcement lacks predicate/reachable witness, planned evidence is called observed, verdict exceeds evaluated population/inference, or dependent verdicts survive material counterevidence without requalification.
